WITH due AS (SELECT id FROM hr_hiring_decisions WHERE status IN ('pending','processing') AND next_attempt_at<=now() ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (
UPDATE hr_hiring_decisions d SET status='processing',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' FROM due WHERE d.id=due.id RETURNING d.*)
SELECT d.*,c.stage,c.email AS candidate_email,c.final_event_id,s.reviewer_emails,
(SELECT max(id) FROM hr_hiring_decisions x WHERE x.candidate_id=d.candidate_id AND x.event_id=d.event_id) AS latest_id
FROM claimed d JOIN candidates c ON c.id=d.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN hr_interview_sessions s ON s.candidate_id=d.candidate_id AND s.interview_type='final' AND s.event_id=d.event_id
UPDATE hr_hiring_decisions SET status='sent',delivered_at=now(),last_error=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
UPDATE hr_hiring_decisions SET status='pending',last_error='DELIVERY_FAILED',next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
UPDATE hr_hiring_decisions SET status=$3,last_error=$4,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
